reviews.title: A great motherboard that offers good stability and performance.
reviews.comment: Just a heads up, you may need a BIOS update to use the new Core Ultra 5/7 250KP/270KP Series 2 Refresh CPUs that Intel released not that long ago as of the date of this review. You likely will not boot as it requires Microcode 0x114 or higher. I've been able to keep a stable overclock on my Crucial 32gb CUDIMM RAM, at around 7600 MT/S. No real issues so far and I have been able to keep my PC going almost all day with no BSODs or random program crashes. The Motherboard features a separate PCIe connector next to the motherboard power connector for added stability to the PCIE slots. Mitigating power spikes and improving stability. The Motherboard has that premium feel and appearance. It is surrounded by a aluminum casing and doesn't feel like its gonna snap on you the moment you attempt to install it, but inserting my RAM modules was a bit tougher than usual. This board is also cheaper than the Z790 hero... which I didn't expect, but is very welcome in this economy. Build Info: CPU:Intel Core Ultra 7 270KP Motherboard: ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO, BIOS Version 3002 RAM: 32gb CUDIMM RAM @7600MT/s GPU: RTX 5090 32GB OC Edition

reviews.title: DOA ASUS Maximus hero motherboard
reviews.comment: The CMOS battery was dead, never had that happen with all of the other boards that I have worked with. The board wouldn't turn on no matter what I did, pulling the RAM, no graphics card connected, even changed my PSU for another one. It had the rgb lights on the board, but no fans or rgb lights on the fans. Pulled the data cable to the 8 tb hard disk drive, still nothing. I've had an i7 and an i9 13900 cpu and didn't have any problems with installation of cpu or ssd drives on ASUS boards, including the dark hero. I just don't trust any manufacture that has done the i9 ultra or the DDR 5 Ram, turned money into a pile of crap is all that I got out of it. I also pulled the fan connectors and checked that I installed the cpu correctly - did see anomalies when I pulled the cpu to send it back for a refund, and I know that I did the installation right with jiggling or moving the cpu around a little to get the right position for cpu installation. Also didn't tighten the liquid cooling block onto the cpu, just a weird board.
